definition: Nīpa tree (Nauclea cadamba) — whose flowers are eaten by bees. The nīpa's 'flower-looked-at body' is released to the bees — an image of surrender.

sources.claim: tava puṣpanirīkṣitāpadehaṃ visṛjeyaṃ sahasaiva nīpa deham

translations.note: No English equivalent; the tree's flowers being eaten by bees is the image — surrender, not destruction.
